newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - VISX Q1 estimate lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - VISX Q1 estimate lowered.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc Thursday lowered its earnings estimate for VISX Inc's earnings in the first quarter of fiscal 1997 to $0.11 from $0.23 and the estimate for all of fiscal 1997 to $1.00 from $1.12.

-- Analyst Beverly Berman said the move followed discussions with VISX management, in which total fiscal 1997 revenues were estimated to be $78.9 million compared to the previous estimate of $92.5 million.
-- Berman added that earnings in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996, which will be reported Januray 29, top her estimate of $0.23 per share by $0.02 or $0.03.
-- She continued to rate VISX a buy.
-- VISX makes lasers used in corneal surgery.
-- Its shares closed down 3/8 Thursday at 23-1/8.
